newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil falls in fast dealings on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil falls in fast dealings on fund selling.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures tumbled early Thursday with nearby contracts in fast dealings on heavy fund selling, traders said.
"Funds were offering it down," a floor trader said. "They hit stops under 80 (23.80 cents per lb) in the March. Refco sold a couple hundred."
The March contract fell 0.32 cent per lb to 23.66 cents but recovered quickly on short covering, floor sources said.
At 0947 CST, soyoil was down 0.20 to 0.10 cent per lb with March off 0.15 at 23.83 cents.
